title: Nationals @ Reds
summary: Nationals bring the cleaner multi-layer case, with the market, listed starter shape, standings profile, and bullpen follow-through all leaning their way at Great American Ball Park.
lean: Lean Nationals if the cleaner starter-to-bullpen chain and standings profile still hold once the late innings start to matter.
factors: Current board: Nationals +140 / Reds -165 | O9 (-120) / U9 (+100) | Nationals +1.5 (-150) / Reds -1.5 (+125).
Nick Lodolo enters with the softer ERA baseline, so early traffic could flip the whole script quickly.
Nationals enter 20-22, 3rd in division, -7 RD; Reds enter 22-20, 5th in division, -39 RD.
Nationals offense: 8.38 H/G with 10.00 over the last three; Reds offense: 7.33 H/G with 8.00 over the last three.
Nationals bullpen: 4.80 ERA and 1.44 WHIP; Reds bullpen: 4.70 ERA and 1.57 WHIP.
swingFactor: Swing factor: whether Lodolo can keep the ball in the yard long enough to stop Great American Ball Park from amplifying an early mistake.
